items.title: Percy Stovall Interview, 1977-12-27
items.q: I'd book John, I never did manage him. I'd book him and he had his first record on him

ctx.x: Well, that record just really went tough off.

It really took off. People knew who he was, you know, and he was behind it. So this guy didn't have any money, and his publishing wasn't right. Everything behind him was all together wrong. It wasn't out he was trying to steal, but he just didn't have the set out. So I told Slim, I said, now the best thing for us to do is not to go back to the couple of the sets. We had no contract with him, nothing. I said, of course, he's not going to be able to give us the right distributor on the record, and we're not going…
Now, didn't you, when did you stop booking Smith?
